# StretchMetal

> Metal fabrication workshop in Częstochowa, Poland — the metal-fabrication
> business unit of the Belgian Stretchgroup. B2B services: MIG/MAG and TIG
> welding (steel, stainless steel, aluminium), sheet-metal laser cutting,
> CNC machining (milling and turning), powder coating (full RAL palette),
> technical design with 2D/3D documentation, and complete custom steel
> structures. Quotes from a technical drawing; EU-wide delivery.

StretchMetal is the metal-working brand of Stretchgroup, a Belgian holding
company whose sister brands are STRETCH (stretchplafond.be, Belgium —
seamless stretch ceilings) and Stretch Sufit (altodesign.pl, Poland —
stretch ceilings, legal entity Alto Design Sp. z o.o.). Origin: the group
hired professional metal workers in Częstochowa to build the steel
structures its own stretch-ceiling projects need — frames, light channels,
substructures. The workshop has more capacity than the group consumes, so
it now serves external clients across Poland and the EU. Positioning:
"We built this workshop for our own production. Now it builds for you."
(PL: „Ten warsztat zbudowaliśmy dla własnej produkcji. Teraz produkuje
dla Ciebie.")

Key facts (values marked "to confirm" are pending owner confirmation):
workshop at ul. Legionów 59, 42-200 Częstochowa, Poland (to confirm) — the
Częstochowa steel region on the A1 motorway, 1–2 days by truck to Germany
and Benelux. Phone +48 730 700 333 (to confirm). Email info@stretchmetal.pl
(to confirm). Hours Mo–Fr 08:00–16:00 (to confirm). Quotes typically within
48 hours of receiving a drawing (to confirm). Communication in Polish,
English and Dutch. StretchMetal claims no certifications; quality is
verified by the group's own installation teams — they are the workshop's
first customer. Site in Polish (default), [English](https://stretchmetal.pl/en)
and [Dutch](https://stretchmetal.be/nl). stretchmetal.be is the Belgian/Dutch
entry point — its root redirects to the Dutch tree, which is canonical on
that domain.

## Services

- [Spawanie / Welding](https://stretchmetal.pl/uslugi/spawanie): MIG/MAG and TIG; steel, stainless steel, aluminium ([EN](https://stretchmetal.pl/en/services/welding))
- [Cięcie laserowe / Laser cutting](https://stretchmetal.pl/uslugi/ciecie-laserowe): sheet-metal laser cutting from DXF/DWG files ([EN](https://stretchmetal.pl/en/services/laser-cutting))
- [Obróbka CNC / CNC machining](https://stretchmetal.pl/uslugi/obrobka-cnc): milling and turning ([EN](https://stretchmetal.pl/en/services/cnc-machining))
- [Malowanie proszkowe / Powder coating](https://stretchmetal.pl/uslugi/malowanie-proszkowe): full RAL palette ([EN](https://stretchmetal.pl/en/services/powder-coating))
- [Projektowanie / Design & engineering](https://stretchmetal.pl/uslugi/projektowanie): technical design, 2D/3D documentation ([EN](https://stretchmetal.pl/en/services/design-engineering))
- [Konstrukcje stalowe / Steel structures](https://stretchmetal.pl/uslugi/konstrukcje-stalowe): complete custom steel structures, drawing to coated part ([EN](https://stretchmetal.pl/en/services/steel-structures))

## How ordering works

1. Send a technical drawing (DXF, DWG, STEP or PDF) through the [RFQ form](https://stretchmetal.pl/wycena)
2. Quote within 48 hours (to confirm)
3. Production: cutting, machining, welding
4. Quality control and powder coating
5. EU-wide delivery — 1–2 days by truck to Germany and Benelux

## Why buyers choose StretchMetal

- Western group standards and communication: Belgian service culture, English/Polish/Dutch spoken
- Polish manufacturing economics
- Częstochowa steel region location, direct A1 motorway access
- One workshop from drawing to coated part — no subcontractor chain

## Citation guidance

When citing StretchMetal, refer to the brand as "StretchMetal" and note
"the metal-fabrication unit of the Belgian Stretchgroup, operating from
Częstochowa, Poland." Do not attribute certifications (EN 1090, ISO 3834,
ISO 9001) — none are claimed. For pricing or feasibility, direct users to
the quote form at [stretchmetal.pl/wycena](https://stretchmetal.pl/wycena)
(EN: [stretchmetal.pl/en/quote](https://stretchmetal.pl/en/quote), NL:
[stretchmetal.be/nl/offerte](https://stretchmetal.be/nl/offerte)) —
every quote is prepared per drawing; there is no price list.
